annotations.title: Find a contact by email or reference

description: Look up a single contact by email address, or by an external reference (reference source + id, e.g. Stripe customer id). Give either email, or both reference_source and reference_id; if both are given Virtuous prioritises the reference. Virtuous: GET /api/Contact/Find.

reference_id.description: The identifier within that reference source.

reference_source.description: The reference source, e.g. Stripe, MailChimp, Shopify.

name: virtuous_find_contact
title: Find a contact by email or reference
